measurement.name: New Guinea Coastal Undercurrent
measurement.range_interpretation: Source O(<20 km) preserves an approximate less-than size description; not a measured 20 km point, rigorous hard bound, 0–20 km interval, uncertainty or seasonal extrema.
measurement.geographic_scope: Local bands near the western exit of Vitiaz Strait; downstream central Bismarck Sea widening retained as context, not a whole-current dimension.
measurement.section_orientation: Local Doppler band breadth; exact transverse orientation and paired coordinates unresolved.
measurement.layer: Subsurface slope-parallel current described near 200 m. No fixed width layer or paired depth-specific edges extracted.
measurement.time_convention: SONNE cruise 113 context (10 October–19 November 1996); exact Doppler width occupations unresolved. March 1999 is publication, not observation.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author-reported order-of-magnitude less-than band size. Exceeding 80 cm/s describes speed, not an adopted width-edge cutoff.
